title: Submission rubric and readiness audit
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for auditing engineering repositories against weighted evaluation rubrics covering problem specificity, verified open-weight and multimodal model usage, modular source and CI depth, and live deployment plus video walkthrough completeness, with tested standard-library Python code.
boundaries: Model and SDK mentions in README prose receive zero tooling points unless corroborated in code or config files.
Live deployment links receive full completeness credit only when paired with an HTTP 200 + SHA-256 probe receipt.
Audit scores guide pre-release engineering remediation and never claim official judging authority.
Workers create nouns and propose verbs; importing this pack writes nothing and enqueues nothing.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for weighted repository readiness and rubric auditing

value.lets_workers: Inventory a local repository checkout, separate wired open-weight and multimodal code integrations from prose claims, check tests, CI, Dockerfiles, live endpoint receipts, and video links, and rank fixes by recoverable points.
value.not_for: Replacing human judges or fabricating live endpoint receipts without probing.

flow.when: First: collect file tree, imports, commit counts, and probe receipts.
Cross-check README claims against actual source and CI artifacts.
Compute weighted pillar points, blockers, and prioritized remediations.

nouns.title: Method: inventory code and receipts first, then score weighted pillars and rank fixes
nouns.category_reason: Shared three-stage audit workflow across repository readiness checks.

lifecycle: inventory-repository-evidence scans README, source modules, tests, workflows, containers, and HTTP probe receipts.
verify-model-and-depth-signals diffs README model claims against source imports and config files.
score-weighted-readiness-rubric totals pillar scores on a 0.0 to 10.0 scale and sorts remediations by recoverable points.

nouns.title: Guardrail: model families named only in README prose earn zero tooling credit

value.rule: Model or adapter claims in documentation that lack matching imports or config artifacts are flagged in unverified_prose_claims as blockers.

nouns.title: Guardrail: full live-endpoint credit requires an HTTP 200 + SHA-256 probe receipt

value.rule: Citing an unverified URL in README.md earns partial documentation credit only and emits a missing-receipt blocker.
value.how_it_is_checked: rubric-checks blocks submission_ready when verified_live_urls is empty.

nouns.title: Deterministic 30/25/20/25 weighted readiness rubric and remediation ranking

value.pillar_weights: impact_specificity 30% (3.0 pts), verified_open_weight_and_multimodal_models 25% (2.5 pts), modular_source_tests_ci_depth 20% (2.0 pts), live_endpoint_and_video_completeness 25% (2.5 pts).
value.remediation_order: Sort missing items descending by recoverable_points so teams fix the largest gaps first.

value.describes: scanned file paths, commit counts, and probe receipts for one repository
weighted pillar points, readiness tier, verified URLs, blockers, and ranked remediations

nouns.title: Deterministic checks for repository readiness scorecards

value.purpose: Deterministic checks every repository readiness scorecard must pass.

deterministic_checks.why: Every scorecard pins a 64-hex SHA-256 audit fingerprint.
readiness_tier must use one of the three defined readiness states.
A repository cannot be marked submission_ready without a verified live URL.
Made-up scorecards must reference loopback or .invalid test endpoints only.

nouns.title: Tool card: rubric_audit standard-library CLI and library

value.name: rubric_audit
value.runtime: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only.
commands: python3 -m rubric_audit score-directory REPO_DIR [--probes PROBES.json] [--commits-in-window N]
does: Audits problem specificity, wired open-weight and multimodal code usage, modular tests/CI/Dockerfiles, and live/video evidence.
Ranks missing items by recoverable rubric points.
does_not: Open outbound sockets, mutate repository files, or certify official contest results.

value.provides: Automated repository health check patterns for CI workflows, tests, and pinned artifacts.

nouns.title: SPDX Specification v2.3 repository and package metadata

value.provides: Deterministic file-level manifest and checksum conventions for software audits.

nouns.title: Worked example: made-up 10.0-point evidence-backed readiness scorecard

value.shows: A repository earning full readiness credit only after code imports, tests, CI, Dockerfile, live receipt, and walkthrough link are verified.

verbs.title: Scan local repository files, imports, commit counts, and probe receipts
verbs.summary: Build a deterministic manifest of local files, source/config blobs, active-window commit counts, and recorded HTTP probe receipts.
verbs.outcome: A structured repository manifest ready for rubric auditing.
network: Reads only the local repository directory and local probe receipt JSON.
steps: Run build_manifest_from_directory via rubric_audit on the local repository path.
Exclude .git, .venv, node_modules, and build caches from file counts.

acceptance.check: files contains at least one tracked path.

verbs.title: Cross-check README model claims against wired source imports and CI depth
verbs.summary: Compare README model/SDK mentions against actual source and config files while verifying modular packages, tests, CI workflows, and container definitions.
verbs.outcome: Verified model families, prose-only claim flags, and engineering depth counts.
steps: Run rubric_audit on the pinned manifest to compare readme_families with code_families.
Flag any prose-only model claim in blockers and withhold tooling points until wired in code.

acceptance.check: Unwired model families appear in blockers.

verbs.title: Compute final weighted rubric score, blockers, and ranked remediations
verbs.summary: Combine all four weighted rubric pillars, check HTTP 200 + SHA-256 live endpoint receipts and walkthrough links, and verify the scorecard against rubric-checks.
verbs.outcome: A checked readiness scorecard with prioritized remediation steps.
steps: Run python3 -m rubric_audit audit on the manifest and compute total_points out of 10.0.
Verify the resulting scorecard passes rubric-checks before returning.
